stages.note: A CI pool runs GitHub Actions runners on machines in your AWS account. It keeps no machine running while no job waits.

steps.d: Runner sizes are classes: small, medium, large, xlarge. GPU classes are not available yet.
Replace <github-org> with your GitHub organization and <cloud-account-id> with the number from mctl cloud-account list. Repeat --classes for more sizes. The cap is for all runners together.
steps.c:
mctl pool create ci --github-org <github-org> --cloud-account <cloud-account-id> \
  --classes medium --max-cost-per-hour 2 --set regions=us-east-1

steps.d: The pool shows its status, classes and GitHub organization. It does not show the GitHub App state: your Multicloud contact sends the GitHub App link (next stage).

stages.note: Multicloud registers a GitHub App in your GitHub organization. The runners use it to receive jobs.

steps.h: Ask your Multicloud contact for the GitHub App link
steps.d: Send the pool name and your GitHub organization. Your contact sends a one-time link. Open it as an owner of the GitHub organization, click Create GitHub App, and do not change the App name. Then install the App on the organization.

stages.note: One label in a workflow sends the job to Multicloud.

steps.d: Save this file as .github/workflows/multicloud-test.yml in a repository of the organization, push it, and start it from the Actions tab (Run workflow). The first job waits a few minutes for a new machine.
steps.c:
name: multicloud-test
on: workflow_dispatch
jobs:
  hello:
    runs-on: multicloud
    steps:
      - run: echo "hello from Multicloud"; nproc; free -g

steps.d: A label works only for a size in the pool's classes. A pool made with --classes medium serves multicloud, multicloud-medium, multicloud-medium-no-spot and multicloud-medium-spot-only. Other sizes: add them first (mctl pool update ci --classes medium,large). Labels per size: multicloud-small, multicloud-large, multicloud-xlarge. Add -no-spot for on-demand only (no interruption), or -spot-only to wait for spot.
A hibernated pool runs no runner and takes no job.
steps.c:
mctl pool hibernate ci
mctl pool wake ci --wait

steps.d: This cannot be undone. Remove the GitHub App from your organization afterwards (GitHub › Settings › GitHub Apps).
